g.data-name: Artwork / fitted bitmap, source preserved separately
EPIC / amethyst and gold, interlaced corner knots, gem rails
Rarity / amethyst and gold, interlaced corner knots, gem rails
Portrait inlay / rank and figure emblems

text.tspan: A master sculptor unites proportion, gesture, and command
of bronze into a figure that seems alive. Such judgment
carries the workshop's tradition forward, making technical
mastery serve an unmistakable human presence.
